biggest_catch: Your friend has to qualify in a serious way: either open checking with a direct deposit of at least $750 per month, or apply for and close on a loan of $7,500+ within 90 days of joining. A friend who just opens a savings account earns you nothing.
catches: New member must open a checking account with a direct deposit of at least $750.00 per month payable to the account holder, OR apply for and close on a loan of $7,500 or more within 90 days of opening membership. Mortgage loans and VISA credit cards do not count.
Referrer earns $50 for every new member who opens a qualifying account; friends/family must live, work, worship, or attend school in Palm Beach County.
$5 initial deposit required for membership (bonus does not count toward it); $5 membership fee waived for referred members.
Velocity Community CU staff, management, and Directors are ineligible to receive referral bonuses.
Program effective 2/1/2015, not retroactive, subject to change at the CU's discretion; member is responsible for all taxes.
No stated referral cap and no stated payout timing on the fetched page.
